description: This file contains implementation of wrapper functions for nl80211 wireless interface management, including event handling, interface configuration, survey and air stats retrieval, antenna and power settings, channel management, and vendor-specific commands.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setEvtListener
methods.description: Registers an event listener for nl80211 events on a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_delEvtListener
methods.description: Removes the event listener for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information for a radio, either via SSID or directly.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setAp
methods.description: Sets the interface type of a radio to Access Point mode.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Sets the interface type of a radio to Station mode.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Configures whether the interface uses 4 MAC addresses.

methods.name: s_addInterface
methods.description: Helper to add a new interface to a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_addInterface
methods.description: Adds a new interface with specified MAC and type.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_addInterfaceExt
methods.description: Adds or configures an interface with extended options.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_addVapInterface
methods.description: Adds a Virtual Access Point (VAP) interface.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_addEpInterface
methods.description: Adds an Endpoint interface.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_addRadios
methods.description: Initializes radios based on existing interfaces.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getWiphyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves wiphy information for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getSurveyInfo
methods.description: Gets survey (channel activity) information for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getAirStatsFromSurveyInfo
methods.description: Calculates air statistics from survey info.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getAirstats
methods.description: Retrieves air statistics for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_updateChanSurveyReportFromSurveyInfo
methods.description: Updates channel survey report based on survey info.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_updateUsageStatsFromSurveyInfo
methods.description: Updates spectrum usage stats from survey info.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setAntennas
methods.description: Sets the transmit and receive antenna configuration.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setTxPowerAuto
methods.description: Sets the transmit power to automatic mode.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setTxPowerFixed
methods.description: Sets the transmit power to a fixed value.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setTxPowerLimited
methods.description: Limits the transmit power to a specified value.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getTxPower
methods.description: Gets the current transmit power.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getMaxTxPowerdBm
methods.description: Retrieves maximum transmit power for a channel.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getChanSpecFromIfaceInfo
methods.description: Gets channel specification from interface info.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getChannel
methods.description: Determines the current channel of a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_setRegDomain
methods.description: Sets the regulatory domain for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_getFirstEnabledVapLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link info for the first enabled VAP.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_bgDfsStart
methods.description: Starts background DFS on a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_bgDfsStop
methods.description: Stops background DFS on a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_registerFrame
methods.description: Registers a frame pattern for vendor-specific handling.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmd
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific command.

methods.name: wld_rad_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmdAttr
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific command with attributes.
